operations.title: Leveraging the Raman response of X-cut thin-film lithium tantalate: broadband Kerr and Raman-Kerr combs via coupling-engineered threshold control
Silicon microring resonator networks for reservoir computing: time-sequence image classification (MNIST/Fashion-MNIST)
A cascaded interferometer-microresonator structure for photonic reservoir computing

operations.method: Web search, 4 scoped queries: (1) thin-film lithium tantalate Kerr/Raman combs; (2) information-processing-capacity bounds for photonic reservoirs; (3) microring reservoir computing 2025-2026; (4) CsPbBr3 perovskite persistent optical memory. Candidate material items verified by fetching arXiv/Nature pages.
operations.result: MATERIAL: arXiv:2607.11186v1 demonstrates 450 nm Kerr and 650 nm Raman-Kerr combs on X-cut TFLT via coupling-engineered threshold control, recasting the strong Raman response from parasitic competitor into enabling mechanism; renews relevance of Raman handling that current kerr-capacity configs reject (ledger 11/14 scope). ACTIVE LINE: microring reservoir computing - arXiv:2509.11721v2 (MRR networks, time-sequence MNIST/Fashion-MNIST) and Sci. Rep. s41598-026-39410-w (linear-regime MZI-MRR time-delay PRC, NARMA-10 NMSE 0.024 with PM, 25 GHz-class speed) extend the Bazzanella 2022 protocol line; both declared as sources. NEGATIVE: no new IPC bounds beyond re-citations of Dambre 2012. NEGATIVE: CsPbBr3 items (oea.2026.250238 holographic display; Kharisova 2025 borogermanate-glass formation) show no persistent writable memory nodes; conj:on3-persistence problem state unchanged. No provenance-free claims introduced.
